description: Internal stakeholders are not identified and their expectations not communicated.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Enterprise governance and leadership functions Strategic planning and risk management teams Organizations subject to regulatory compliance requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for absence of stakeholder identification documents, missing stakeholder needs assessments, lack of documented communication channels with internal stakeholders regarding cybersecurity expectations, no evidence of stakeholder input in security planning processes.
